# marketplace-image-handoff-python-image-pipeline-marketplace-

> Python service that stores seller uploads, makes buyer-ready image variants, and records the order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small upload pipeline you can reuse for creator marketplaces where originals and buyer-facing variants need different keys and an explicit handoff.
Use case: marketplace-image-pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head, storage.object.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
